hints.text_en: A glob only counts when it expands to a real directory entry; quoted or unmatched symbols stay literal.

hints.text_en: Create a one-character filename so both * and ? have a deterministic match.
hints.text_zh: 先创建一个单字符文件名，让 * 与 ? 都能得到确定的匹配。

hints.text_en: Run: touch a
hints.text_zh: 运行：touch a

hints.text_en: Then pass both patterns to a harmless command: echo * ?
hints.text_zh: 然后把两个模式交给无害命令：echo * ?

hints.text_en: Full solution: touch a && echo * ?
hints.text_zh: 完整解答：touch a && echo * ?

hints.text_en: A heredoc starts with cat <<WORD and ends only when WORD appears alone on a later line.

hints.text_en: Review the basics of IO Redirection commands.
hints.text_zh: 复习IO Redirection相关命令的基础知识。

hints.text_en: Start with cat <<EOF, enter one or more message lines, then enter EOF.
hints.text_zh: 先输入 cat <<EOF，再输入一行或多行消息，最后单独输入 EOF。

hints.text_en: The closing delimiter must match exactly and contain no extra spaces.
hints.text_zh: 结束标记必须完全匹配，且不能带额外空格。

hints.text_en: Full solution: enter cat <<EOF, then Mission ready, then EOF on its own line.
hints.text_zh: 完整解答：依次输入 cat <<EOF、Mission ready，并在最后单独输入 EOF。

summary_en: Inspect a live process, stop it deliberately, confirm the state transition, and resume the same PID.
summary_zh: 检查活动进程，有意停止它，确认状态转换，再恢复同一个 PID。

story.briefing_en: BOSS BATTLE: Prove that you can distinguish a stopped process from a zombie. Use PID 1842, observe it, stop it, then resume it without terminating it.
story.briefing_zh: Boss战：证明你能区分停止进程与僵尸进程。观察 PID 1842，停止它，再在不终止它的情况下恢复。
story.success_en: Process 1842 was stopped and resumed with an evidence-backed signal sequence.
story.success_zh: 已通过可验证的信号序列停止并恢复进程 1842。
story.failure_en: Mission incomplete. Review Process Management fundamentals and try again.

objectives.label_en: Restore the stopped process without terminating it
objectives.label_zh: 在不终止进程的情况下恢复它

hints.text_en: A stopped process remains alive; a zombie has exited and awaits reaping. This simulator models the stopped-state workflow.
hints.text_zh: 停止进程仍然存活；僵尸进程已经退出并等待回收。本模拟器建模的是停止状态流程。

hints.text_en: Use ps -ef to identify PID 1842 before sending any signal.
hints.text_zh: 发送任何信号前，先用 ps -ef 确认 PID 1842。

hints.text_en: SIGSTOP pauses the process; SIGCONT resumes that same stopped process.
hints.text_zh: SIGSTOP 暂停进程；SIGCONT 恢复同一个已停止进程。

hints.text_en: Run the signals in order against PID 1842. Do not substitute another PID.
hints.text_zh: 按顺序向 PID 1842 发送信号，不要替换成其他 PID。

hints.text_en: Full solution: ps -ef && kill -STOP 1842 && kill -CONT 1842
hints.text_zh: 完整解答：ps -ef && kill -STOP 1842 && kill -CONT 1842

hints.text_en: A complete screen lifecycle has three observable steps: create, detach with the screen prefix, and reattach.
hints.text_zh: 完整的 screen 生命周期包含三个可观察步骤：创建、使用 screen 前缀分离、再重新连接。

hints.text_en: Create a named session with screen -S work.
hints.text_zh: 使用 screen -S work 创建命名会话。

hints.text_en: Inside screen, press Ctrl-a and then d to detach.
hints.text_zh: 进入 screen 后，依次按 Ctrl-a 与 d 完成分离。

hints.text_en: Back at the shell, run screen -r work to reattach the same session.
hints.text_zh: 回到 Shell 后运行 screen -r work，重新连接同一会话。

hints.text_en: Full solution: screen -S work; press Ctrl-a d; then run screen -r work.
hints.text_zh: 完整解答：screen -S work；按 Ctrl-a d；然后运行 screen -r work。

hints.text_en: nohup changes hangup handling, while a trailing & requests background execution; they solve different parts of the problem.
hints.text_zh: nohup 改变挂断处理，末尾的 & 请求后台执行；二者解决的是不同问题。

hints.text_en: The simulator executes the child deterministically but records the background operator as a bounded shell event.
hints.text_zh: 模拟器会确定性执行子命令，同时把后台运算符记录为有界 Shell 事件。

hints.text_en: Use true as a harmless child command.
hints.text_zh: 使用 true 作为无害的子命令。

hints.text_en: Place & at the end of the complete nohup invocation.
hints.text_zh: 把 & 放在完整 nohup 命令的末尾。

hints.text_en: Full solution: nohup true &
hints.text_zh: 完整解答：nohup true &
